nodes.label: Lúmen Gestão Financeira Design System
nodes.rationale: Personal finance dashboard for Brazilian users built on the principle that financial data should feel like reading a serious newspaper — precise, high-contrast, and completely free of decorative noise. Uses Swiss Style editorial minimalism with utilitarian rigour. Rebranded from Rattio to Lúmen on 01/05/2026.

nodes.label: Financial Newspaper Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: The aesthetic balances the intellectual weight of a traditional broadsheet with the high-velocity precision of modern fintech. Prioritizes information density, legibility, and structural authority over decorative reassurance. Dividers (not whitespace) separate sections, mimicking print newspaper structural rules.

nodes.label: Single-Hue Brand Color Discipline
nodes.rationale: Teal 700 (#0F766E) is the sole saturated brand color, used on primary buttons, active sidebar state, focus rings, and chart income bars — all tied to one meaning. Semantic colors (Emerald for income, Red for expense) are deliberately separate, following financial convention without competing with the teal brand.

nodes.label: Financial Precision Through Tabular Numbers
nodes.rationale: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code handles all financial figures with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums — numbers align vertically in columns, and the slightly condensed tracking packs more digits into tight card spaces without sacrificing legibility.

nodes.label: Hero Balance Component
nodes.rationale: 60px Inter Bold at letter-spacing -0.03em — the most important number, the 'lede' users should read from across the room. The burnt-orange rule (#C2410C at 30% opacity) below it is the only purely decorative element in the entire design system, referencing newspaper column dividers.

nodes.label: KPI Cards with Colored Accent Bars
nodes.rationale: Four KPI cards (Income, Expenses, Balance, Investment) each carry a 3px colored accent bar along the top edge for at-a-glance variant recognition without coloring the entire background. Three tiers of information in 80px of vertical space: uppercase label at 11px → mono value at 22px → delta arrow with percentage.

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation with Navy Background
nodes.rationale: Deep navy (#0A1628) sidebar functions as the masthead while the near-white (#F8FAFC) main canvas is the broadsheet page. Active state uses a 3px teal left-edge bar rather than a full background fill. Each nav item shows a Fira Code keyboard shortcut badge on hover.

nodes.label: Financial Health Score
nodes.rationale: A single 0–100 score computed across four financial criteria (savings rate, budget adherence, active goals, positive balance). Score bar uses transition width 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) — spring easing that makes the fill feel alive, not mechanical.

nodes.label: Editorial Bar Chart Design
nodes.rationale: Bar charts use thin 12px bars with rounded tops only, reading as clean vertical marks rather than chunky BI-style pillars. Chart grid lines are dashed (3 3) at 50% opacity — present for alignment but invisible at a glance. Tooltips are minimal with 2px border radius.

nodes.label: Transaction List Items with Expanding Row
nodes.rationale: Each transaction item uses padding 14px 0 with a bottom border — no card wrapping. On hover, the item gains a background fill and momentarily shifts padding to 14px 10px with negative margin (-10px) — the expanding row pattern that adds visual depth without layout reflow.
